mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consulta ( id_paciente, id_medico, id_cita, fecha_consulta, peso, talla, imc, id_dieta, observaciones ) VALUES ( #{idPaciente}, #{idMedico}, #{idCita}, COALESCE( ( SELECT TIMESTAMP(ci.fecha_cita, ci.hora_cita) FROM cita ci WHERE ci.id_cita = #{idCita} ), #{fechaConsulta} ), #{peso}, #{talla}, #{imc}, #{idDieta}, #{observaciones} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cita SET estatus = 'Asistida' WHERE id_cita = #{idCita} AND estatus IN ('Confirmada', 'Reagendada')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id_consulta AS idConsulta, c.id_paciente AS idPaciente, c.id_medico AS idMedico, c.id_cita AS idCita, DATE_FORMAT( CASE WHEN c.id_cita IS NOT NULL AND ci.id_cita IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMP(ci.fecha_cita, ci.hora_cita) ELSE c.fecha_consulta END, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS fechaConsulta, c.peso, c.talla, c.imc, c.id_dieta AS idDieta, d.nombre_dieta AS nombreDieta, IFNULL(c.cancelada, 0) AS cancelada, c.observaciones FROM consulta c LEFT JOIN cita ci ON ci.id_cita = c.id_cita LEFT JOIN dieta d ON d.id_dieta = c.id_dieta WHERE c.id_paciente = #{idPaciente} ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.id_cita IS NOT NULL AND ci.id_cita IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMP(ci.fecha_cita, ci.hora_cita) ELSE c.fecha_consulta END DESC

SELECT c.id_consulta AS idConsulta, c.id_paciente AS idPaciente, c.id_medico AS idMedico, c.id_cita AS idCita, DATE_FORMAT( CASE WHEN c.id_cita IS NOT NULL AND ci.id_cita IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMP(ci.fecha_cita, ci.hora_cita) ELSE c.fecha_consulta END, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS fechaConsulta, c.peso, c.talla, c.imc, c.id_dieta AS idDieta, d.nombre_dieta AS nombreDieta, IFNULL(c.cancelada, 0) AS cancelada, c.observaciones FROM consulta c LEFT JOIN cita ci ON ci.id_cita = c.id_cita INNER JOIN paciente p ON p.id_paciente = c.id_paciente LEFT JOIN dieta d ON d.id_dieta = c.id_dieta
AND c.id_medico = #{idMedico}
AND ( p.nombre LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criterio}, '%') OR p.primer_apellido LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criterio}, '%') OR p.segundo_apellido LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criterio}, '%') OR CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido, p.segundo_apellido) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criterio}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.id_cita IS NOT NULL AND ci.id_cita IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMP(ci.fecha_cita, ci.hora_cita) ELSE c.fecha_consulta END DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE consulta SET peso = #{peso}, talla = #{talla}, imc = #{imc}, id_dieta = #{idDieta}, observaciones = #{observaciones} WHERE id_consulta = #{idConsulta}
UPDATE consulta SET cancelada = 1 WHERE id_consulta = #{idConsulta} AND cancelada = 0
